config.exportBrowserPath: Chrome/Edge executable path for PDF, images, preview and printing. Empty automatically finds an installed browser. No browser is downloaded.
config.typography: MarkLeaf typography. Defaults to Web · Minimal; explicit user/workspace choices are preserved.
extension.description: Read and edit Markdown visually with math, Mermaid and an outline. Compare changes in VS Code’s native text diff.
walkthrough.title: Get started with MarkLeaf
walkthrough.description: Open a document, edit Markdown and compare changes in VS Code.
walkthrough.open.title: Open a document or a diff
walkthrough.open.description: Open Markdown in MarkLeaf. Use MarkLeaf: Open Document for other readable files. Git comparisons open in the text diff editor.
walkthrough.format.title: Tables, formulas and diagrams
walkthrough.format.description: Set column widths in Format. Select a formula or diagram and click it again to edit its source. Use Export to save a selected diagram as SVG or 2× PNG.
walkthrough.settings.title: Reading and source controls
walkthrough.settings.description: Open the outline from View. Use the status bar for source, encoding, line endings and zoom.
config.adaptiveJustification: Apply desktop adaptive justification to eligible paragraphs.
config.allowTableColumnResize: Enable dragging and adjusting table column widths.
